Frontend: 25/25 functional assertions pass (hero IT title, NO testimonials/case-history sections, blueprint-section with 3 layers + stats + principle quote, nav-link-blueprint clickable+#blueprint scroll, elite-badge with 'Elite' text, back-to-main-site -> https://arxeon.ch, tier-card-1=Donapp, 13 pillars, 5 orbit nodes, no 'Donna 2.0' string anywhere, IT->FR switch updates blueprint title to 'L'anatomie d'une Usine IA.', contact form fills+submits+success state, mobile-menu opens with all 5 nav links). minor.issue: Latent: original concern about logger forward-reference is now RESOLVED — logger is initialised at module-top before routes. No action needed.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile viewports (<640px) the desktop CTA button 'CONSULTAZIONE' remains visible and pushes the mobile-menu-toggle outside the viewport. Measured: viewport=390px, document.body.scrollWidth=464px, mobile-menu-toggle bounding box x=467 (beyond viewport). Root cause: the .btn-ghost custom CSS class declares 'display: inline-flex' which overrides Tailwind's 'hidden' utility because the custom stylesheet is loaded after Tailwind's utilities (CSS specificity is equal, last one wins). The user must scroll horizontally to reach the hamburger.

issues: Pre-existing: hero title spans render visually spaced via margin but textContent collapses to 'L'Aziendachesigestiscedasola.' (literal spaces are present this iteration in JSX but spans + margin still affect SR / DOM readouts). Confirmed unchanged from iteration_1.
See ui_bugs above — header-cta should be hidden below 640px to avoid horizontal overflow.

action_items: Fix Header.jsx mobile overflow: ensure .btn-ghost respects Tailwind utilities. Quick fix options: (a) add `!hidden sm:!inline-flex` to header-cta to force the Tailwind class to win, OR (b) wrap CTA in a hidden-on-mobile div, OR (c) raise specificity of the `hidden` rule, OR (d) remove `display: inline-flex` from .btn-ghost base and only apply on a modifier.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx: hidden-sm-inline-flex pattern is being overridden by .btn-ghost custom display — class ordering in CSS bundles can silently break responsiveness. Tailwind utilities should use ! prefix or be authored as layer utilities to guarantee priority over component classes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend unchanged & green. All blueprint section data-testids present and verified. Language switch IT<->FR works. Contact form e2e works. Mobile menu HTML is correct and opens via click — but the mobile-menu-toggle button itself sits at x≈467 on a 390px viewport because the desktop header-cta button overflows. Functional click works via JS / horizontal scroll, but a real user on mobile cannot tap the hamburger without scrolling. Fix is a one-line className change.
rca_of_the_issue: REPRO: set viewport to 390x844, navigate to /. Observe header 'CONSULTAZIONE' button is visible. Inspect mobile-menu-toggle: getBoundingClientRect().x = 467, document.body.scrollWidth = 464, window.innerWidth = 390. The hamburger is rendered to the right of the visible area. CAUSE: <a data-testid='header-cta' className='hidden sm:inline-flex btn-ghost'> — Tailwind's `.hidden { display: none }` and the project's custom `.btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; ... }` have equal CSS specificity (both single class); whichever appears later in the compiled stylesheet wins. In this build .btn-ghost wins, so `hidden` is ineffective at <640px. MITIGATION: use Tailwind's important modifier (`!hidden sm:!inline-flex`) on header-cta, or remove `display: inline-flex` from .btn-ghost base and apply it through a Tailwind layer utility, or change the class order so `.hidden` is appended later.
